'''Cardiac tamponode''' was an emergency condition caused by the accumulation of fluid in the sac that contained the [[Heart/Legends|heart]]. During the [[Battle of Drongar]], the injured [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[CT-802]] experienced this condition.
